propositions: REBAR_OPCERT_PRIVATE_KEY environment variable is read into config.private_key but never removed from os.environ, leaving it accessible to child processes and environment dumps
Child processes spawned after config load (ssh-keygen, git) inherit the raw inline PEM from os.environ because they do not receive an explicit env parameter
The config value should be consumed (popped) from os.environ in _private_key_env rather than copied, to remove the secret from the process environment after config composition
A second call to OpcertServiceConfig.from_env in the same process should return private_key=None and not raise, establishing consume-once semantics for any future reload path
The REBAR_OPCERT_KEY_PATH file-path source must remain unaffected and continue to be present in os.environ after the inline-PEM pop operation
